meta.scope: Australian $1 catalogue covering the complete Royal Australian Mint circulation table plus base-metal $1 partner-program designs issued through Woolworths and Australia Post. Proof, precious-metal and mintmark-only products are excluded.
meta.important: Every official core circulating $1 issue is included, together with the identifiable base-metal $1 designs in the Mint's Woolworths and Australia Post program archive.
meta.personal_data_rule: Catalogue updates must not overwrite My Mint records.
